title: Domestic Violence Definitions
key_points: Lists the offenses that are domestic violence when committed against a protected person (homicide, assault, threats, kidnapping, restraint, false imprisonment, sexual offenses, lewdness, criminal mischief, burglary, trespass, harassment, stalking, cyber-harassment, contempt, coercion, robbery, and others).

Victim: an adult or emancipated minor abused by a current or former spouse, or by someone who lives or lived in the same household; anyone with a child in common or expected; anyone in a dating relationship.
